name: apollo
description: Apollo prospecting and enrichment — official MCP server (people/company search, enrichment, validation, research)

requirements: OAuth 2.0 (interactive clients) or a MASTER API key for headless clients
Credits available for company search, enrichment, validation and research
notes: Headless clients send a MASTER key in the X-Api-Key header; scoped keys are rejected with 403 API_INACCESSIBLE.
People search (apollo_mixed_people_api_search) reads and consumes no credits.
Company search, enrichment, validation and research consume credits.
Destructive bulk delete is not supported.
Apollo prohibits AI model training on its data.
